name: EPE Capital Partners Ltd.
source: Audited consolidated statements of comprehensive income, EPE Capital Partners Limited, year ended 30 June 2025 | depth extended to FY2026,FY2025,FY2024,FY2023,FY2022,FY2021 from StockAnalysis income-statement (overlap 15/28 reproduced), read 2026-11-13 | CRON 20261118 12:00: FY2026 Revenue -291,541 and Net Finance Costs -5,457 filled from the audited consolidated statement of comprehensive income for the year ended 30 June 2026 (printed page 52, Group column, R thousand stored as absolute rand). Revenue is the statement total (loss)/income line, which is the same line the stored FY2025 figure of 701,134 came from. The rows tie to the figures already stored for that year: revenue less operating expenses of 20,330 gives the stored operating loss of 311,870, and operating loss plus finance costs of 5,457 gives the stored loss before tax of 317,330. Source document: https://ethoscapital.mu/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/EPECAP0626.pdf

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.derivedNote: Income Tax = Profit Before Tax less Net Profit, both printed in this file (FY2026 -317,330,000 less -323,270,000 equals 5,940,000). The identity reproduces all five other years exactly: 1,249,000; 1,557,000; 1,511,000; 3,039,000; 4,979,000.

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.formula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.formula: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.formula: Debt to Equity = Total Liabilities / Total Equity

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

note: South African rand. The statements print thousands; figures here are the full amounts. Revenue is total income, which is dominated by the change in fair value of investments (699,167,000 in 2025). Operating expenses are total expenses, so they already contain the finance costs line, which is shown separately and is not deducted a second time. Operating profit therefore equals profit before tax. Cost of sales, gross profit and earnings per share are not printed on the face of the statement.

derivation.note: rows tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures, not printed in the source

derivedCellsNote: CRON 2026-11-16: FY2026 Income Tax filled as Profit Before Tax less Net Profit from the printed rows; identity verified exact on the five other years.
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024, FY2022: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged. Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2023: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed.
